title: How long should I allow between 1.5-tonne batches in a quench tank?
summary: Single-batch workpiece capacity is not enough to establish the interval between successive quenches. Suneng's 2016 quench-bath proposal lists a rated batch of 1.5 t, quenching-fluid temperature rise and cooling time, with agitation and a separate heat-exchange circuit. Check the incoming heat load, fluid conditions and next-batch arrival time together; do not schedule continuous production from 1.5 t alone.
